tasks.title: Create a Neon API key (only for apps customers pay App Engine to build)
tasks.why: Your own apps stay on the shared Supabase, and nothing about them changes. Your ruling (LPL 03 §7, 2026-06-18) gives each app a CUSTOMER buys through App Engine its own free Neon database, so their data stays out of your Supabase. Without the key, those customer apps launch with no database, so paid App Engine checkout stays off. If you'd rather put customer apps on Supabase too, click Not doing this and add a note saying so.
steps: Sign in at neon.com (the free plan allows 100 projects)
Account settings → API keys → Create new API key
Save it as NEON_API_KEY on the dashboard Keys page (/integrations)
Tell an agent so it can set APP_ENGINE_FLAT_CHECKOUT_ENABLED=true and run the first paid build

tasks.title: Replace the exposed live Stripe key with a new one that also allows Stripe Connect
tasks.why: A live key was pasted and stored in ep_api_credentials on 2026-08-25, and only rotating it fixes that. The current restricted key also gets a 403 on /v1/accounts, so giving produces no gift records for ChurchConnect.
steps: Stripe → Developers → API keys → create a new restricted key and include write access to Accounts (/v1/accounts)

Give it to an agent to set STRIPE_API_KEY on easypeazy-api, STRIPE_SECRET_KEY on ai-website-design (if it is the same Stripe account) and STRIPE_SECRET_KEY on app-engine, which uses EasyPeazy's key, then redeploy and check /health?deep=1
Revoke the old key only after that check passes
